item.title: California measles outbreaks linked to pockets of unvaccinated residents
item.description: California health departments are fighting to contain measles outbreaks as cases rise and resources shrink. Investigating communicable diseases is time-intensive and expensive. Officials say teams have about 72 hours after a positive case to find exposed people and stop spread.

item.title: Newsom directs $291M to combat homelessness, touts Alameda Co. as model of success
item.description: Gov. Newsom recognized the success in Alameda County while announcing accountability measures for underperforming counties.

item.title: United flight to New Jersey returns to LAX due to engine issue; plane evacuated
item.description: A United Airlines flight was forced to evacuate at LAX over reports of an engine fire, the LAFD said.

item.title: Gov. Newsom condemns Trump administration's attack on Iran, raises concerns over energy costs
item.description: "We have to reconcile why our bombs were used or Israeli bombs were used to kill children, young girls at a school, and what the imminent threat was," Newsom said.

item.title: Man killed in hit-and-run while changing flat tire on 5 Freeway in Castaic
item.description: A 22-year-old man was struck and killed in a hit-and-run after pulling over to fix a flat tire on the 5 Freeway in Castaic, authorities say.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks law against schools outing transgender students to their parents in California
item.description: The Supreme Court cleared the way for California schools to tell parents if their children identify as transgender without getting the student's approval.

item.title: Children's and Family Emmy Awards held in NYC; Disney shatters record for most nominations
item.description: The Walt Disney Company shattered the record for most nominations, receiving 102.

item.title: Sunny, mild weather moves into SoCal before gusty winds arrive
item.description: Southern California will see a mostly sunny and mild week before a wind event moves in, bringing gusty winds to much of the region.

item.title: Police officer shot, suspect killed in Pasadena gun battle
item.description: A police officer was wounded and a suspect was killed following a gun battle in Pasadena, officials say.

item.title: Economists say soaring oil and gas prices could impact cost of other goods
item.description: The conflict in the Middle East is set to impact the cost of gas, as well as many other products, with passage through the Strait of Hormuz compromised.
